_doc: Decision inventory of the original bot (Agent A). Lines refer to git HEAD bot/src (== references/original-src for .cpp/.h except bot.h friend lines). Generated by tools/audit_inventory.py from anchors; head ids from schemas/heads.json. "hook" = where a head call goes so that the teacher choice is fully computed before it and an alternative of the same type can be substituted; captures are in agents/A/patches/03_teacher_capture.diff.
